decisions.reason: As a recently launched cardboard display close to the firm's core offer, it is a low-cost option to keep open while demand becomes clearer.
This pegboard-back cardboard display fits existing design and production capabilities, so the firm would likely retain it until market response is better revealed.
Although it overlaps with other quarter-pallet concepts, it is still close to the established business and inexpensive to continue offering for another year.
The eighth-pallet format extends the firm's familiar display range and likely costs little to keep on the market relative to its option value.
